commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text: Water loses its own nature and takes on that of the ground it joins. In the same way, people’s understanding changes and takes on the nature of the group they join. In the sky water is itself, and on earth its colour and taste change. Alone, understanding is itself, and in a group its way of seeing changes.
